reading_title_html: It Is Essential That the Master Be Present

reading.rtitle: It Is Essential That the Master Be Present
paras: Port state control exists because a flag state cannot inspect a ship that is never in its waters. The rules require that every ship in a member port be open to inspection. Any deficiency found is recorded against the ship, not against the inspector who found it. Detention follows only when the officer thinks the ship is not seaworthy.

The convention requires that the master notify the maritime authority at once about any problem with seaworthiness. It also recommends that all crew members complete the drill before departure. Look at the verbs: notify and complete, not notifies and completes. After requires, recommends and it is essential that, formal English uses the base form.

A surveyor may issue a certificate and an endorsement. But the surveyor may not decide that a deficiency is unimportant. That decision belongs to the authority, so a person who never saw the ship reviews each detention.

Critics say that a ship can have every certificate and still be unseaworthy on the day of the inspection. That is true. But port state control does something useful: the ship with the problem pays for it, in that port, on that day. It is essential that it stay that way.

reading2_title_html: Text Two: Not a Ship in Sight

paras: For a long time, a standard of measurement was an object. The metre was a metal bar kept near Paris, and the kilogram was a metal cylinder kept next to it. Anyone could, in theory, go and look at them.

The problem with an object is that it changes. Over a hundred years, the kilogram cylinder lost a little mass, or its copies gained some. Nobody could say which, because the cylinder was the definition. It is essential that a standard be independent of the thing it measures.

In 2019, scientists found a solution. They defined the units with constants of nature. The kilogram now depends on the Planck constant, and the metre on the speed of light. Nothing is kept in a safe, and any good laboratory can produce the units.
The new definitions are not more accurate for everyday use. A kitchen scale is as good as before. The real change is that the system no longer depends on one piece of metal.

listenings.sub: A port state control officer talks about his job. Sound first, no text.
listenings.text: People often ask me if I enjoy detaining ships. I have detained eleven ships in nine years, and I did not enjoy it once. My decision is very narrow. I record what I find. If the lifeboat gear was not serviced, that is a deficiency, and it goes on the record. The master can agree or not. But I do not decide if it matters. The rules require that every deficiency be recorded against the ship. Detention is a different decision. A person in an office, who never saw the ship, reviews it. That is not a weakness. It is the design of the system.
questions: How many ships has he detained?
What does he do when he finds a problem?
He records it as a deficiency, against the ship.

teacher.s1: Abertura (1 min): Aula de SIMULADO que fecha o bloco 2, no NIVEL NOVO (pedido da professora em 28/09): textos mais curtos, frases simples, glossario na tela, 1 listening so e as respostas por ESCRITO. A prova do PS-ASON e 100% leitura. Hoje: dois textos curtos no formato da prova, um deles sem navio nenhum.
teacher.s2: Warm-up (3 min): Ela escolhe UM chip. Nao peca explicacao longa: uma frase basta. Anote a escolha e compare no debrief.
teacher.s3: Provocacao (3 min): Ela escolhe A ou B. Espere 5 segundos antes de ajudar. Resposta: B (e ingles regulatorio correto, a forma base depois de requires that). Se ela escolher A, e exatamente a opcao errada que a prova oferece.
teacher.s4: Objetivo (1 min): Leia as tres missoes. Diga: today you answer in writing.
teacher.s5: Transicao vocab (1 min): Diga: Ten words of an inspection. Passe ao proximo.
teacher.s6: Vocab reveal 1-4 (4 min): maritime authority, surveyor, certificate, endorsement. NAO traduza. CCQ com opcoes: Endorsement: a new document, or an addition to a certificate? (An addition.)
teacher.s7: Vocab reveal 5-7 (4 min): port state control, deficiency, detention. CCQ com opcoes: Is a deficiency the same as a detention, yes or no? (No: pode haver deficiency sem detention.)
teacher.s8: Vocab reveal 8-10 (4 min): seafarer, competency, seaworthiness. CCQ com opcoes: Is the cook a seafarer, yes or no? (Yes.)
teacher.s9: Consolidate (3 min): Ela liga os pares sozinha. Ajude so se ela pedir.
teacher.s10: Transicao (1 min): Diga: Text one. Questions first. O proximo slide e o de TAREFA: as perguntas ANTES do texto.
teacher.s11: Texto 1 (8 min): Leitura silenciosa. Mostre o GLOSSARIO antes de ela comecar. Cronometre sem pressao: diga o tempo so no fim. Se ela travar numa palavra fora do glossario, de um sinonimo simples em ingles.
teacher.s12: Gist (2 min): Ela escolhe a opcao e ESCREVE a linha do texto que prova. Resposta: (c).
teacher.s13: True or False (5 min): Ela responde as cinco e escreve a linha que prova cada uma. So depois voces conferem. A 2 e a 5 sao trocas de AGENTE (inspector x ship; quem revisa).
teacher.s14: Transicao gramatica (1 min): Diga: The verb from slide 3 is in the text. Passe ao proximo.
teacher.s15: Grammar discovery (5 min): A forma base hoje e so para LER, nao para produzir. Pergunte o que vem ANTES do that nos tres exemplos. So entao clique Reveal the Rule. CCQ com opcoes: notify here: a mistake, or correct formal English? (Correct.)
teacher.s16: Practice (4 min): Ela escreve a forma base ANTES de clicar. O quinto item e o NEGATIVO (not sail, sem does).
teacher.s17: Spot the error (3 min): Os quatro trocam a forma base pela forma comum (notifies, is, does not). As frases erradas soam naturais: por isso caem na prova.
teacher.s18: Transicao equivalencia (1 min): Diga: Same fact, other words. Passe ao proximo.
teacher.s19: Como a prova esconde (3 min): Leia os quatro pares com ela. O quarto (a kitchen scale is as good as before = everyday measurement was unaffected) e do texto sem navio.
teacher.s20: Equivalencia (4 min): Ela liga os pares. Ajude so depois de 5 segundos.
teacher.s21: Complete (4 min): Uma lacuna por vez. As oito respostas estao no banco de palavras.
teacher.s22: Quick fire POR ESCRITO (6 min): Ela escreve a resposta de cada uma no chat ou no papel, e so depois voces abrem as dicas. Nao exija resposta oral longa.
teacher.s22a: Texto 2 (7 min): Este texto NAO tem navio, de proposito: a prova de 2025 abriu com um texto da Britannica. Mostre o GLOSSARIO. Cronometre sem pressao.
teacher.s22b: True or False do texto 2 (5 min): TRUE ou FALSE e a linha que prova, POR ESCRITO. A 4 e a de GRAU: not more accurate for everyday use.
teacher.s23: Transicao debrief (1 min): Diga: One recording, then you write. Passe ao proximo.
teacher.s24: Listening (5 min): O UNICO listening da aula (pedido da professora). LEIA AS 3 PERGUNTAS EM VOZ ALTA COM ELA ANTES de tocar. Primeira vez em 0.75x, segunda em 1x. E o lado humano do texto 1 e da base para a escrita do proximo slide.
teacher.s25: Writing (5 min): Ela escreve tres frases sobre o inspetor, uma por inicio. Corrija por escrito so o essencial (verbo e palavra tecnica). Depois clique Show a Model Answer.
teacher.s26: Debrief guiado POR ESCRITO (5 min): Tres questoes, uma frase para cada: a opcao e a linha que prova. NAO aceite so achei que era essa: peca a linha.
teacher.s27: Debrief semi-livre POR ESCRITO (5 min): Ela escolhe uma frase falsa e escreve duas frases: o que a opcao diz e o que o texto diz. Use o banco de palavras.
teacher.s28: Producao (4 min): Ela ESCREVE tres frases (Now I can / It is still difficult / Next I want) e depois LE em voz alta. Esse e o unico momento de fala da fase: curto e com roteiro.
teacher.s29: Transicao wrap-up (1 min): Diga: Block two, closed.
teacher.s30: Survival card (3 min): Cinco frases dos dois textos. Toque e peca repeticao, uma vez cada: ouvir that the master notify ajuda a parar de corrigir para notifies.
teacher.s31: Checklist (2 min): Leia cada item em voz alta. Os 5 checks fecham a aula e acendem o stamp.
teacher.s32: Encerramento (2 min): Diga: Block two complete, Helena. HOMEWORK ORALMENTE, nunca escrito na tela: (1) achar tres frases com requires that ou it is essential that num texto real da IMO (SOLAS, STCW, ISM) e sublinhar o verbo na forma base; (2) refazer por escrito as questoes de hoje que ela errou, com a linha que prova. Proxima aula: The Language of Maritime Contracts.
teacher.s25b: Writing: resumo (5 min): Uma frase por texto, com as palavras DELA. E o treino de equivalencia ao contrario: se ela copiar a frase do texto, peca outra palavra. Depois clique Show a Model Answer e compare.
